objective.name: sandbox.inspect.resolved.inputs
objective.description: Resolve incoming matter refs inside the wrapper and return both aggregated params and resolved matter payloads.

#root.role: Expose aggregated params and resolve local wrapper-owned plus remote Brique matters inside the wrapper runtime.

effects.wrapper_matter_read: A wrapper-owned matter may be read natively.
effects.remote_matter_read: A remote Brique matter may be read through outbound routing.

transformation_contract.morphing: Aggregated params and incoming matter refs become explicit params plus resolved local-wrapper and remote-Brique matter payloads.
invariants: primary is resolved through the local wrapper matter manager when present.
secondary is resolved through an outbound matter.read call when present.
The capability preserves the original received params alongside resolved matter content.
success: On success, sandbox.inspect.resolved.inputs returns received_params, resolved_matters, ctx_id, and wrapper_name.
Resolved local and remote matter payloads are partitioned under resolved_matters by logical input name.
failure: sandbox.inspect.resolved.inputs has no contract-level validation failure for missing @matter entries because each binding is optional.
The capability fails if local wrapper matter resolution or outbound remote matter resolution cannot complete.
notes: This is the strongest wrapper input oracle in N7 for mixed params plus @matter scenarios.
The payload shape intentionally separates raw received_params from resolved_matters.
